prompt.alinti: If you want to get better front-end designs, then instead of prompting from scratch,
you can just use the design language of all the top brands, like Tesla, Apple, Ferrari, and even Anthropic, and put them directly in your work.
Somebody just reverse-engineered over 2,000 websites from the world's top brands
and put them all in design files that your cloud code can read and use directly.
And every file contains their entire visual system, the exact colors, fonts, spacing, and layouts they use,
plus clear rules on what to do and what not to do.
So just pick the one that fits your project, drop it right in your coding agent,
and it'll literally build your entire UI in that exact style in minutes.
Plus, the whole library is completely free right now,
so if you want to try it for yourselves, just comment 'design' down below, and I'll DM you the link directly.
